product_metadata.title: Zonon Flexible Mirror Sheets Self Adhesive Non Glass Mirror Tiles Mirror Stickers for Home Wall Decor (35 Pieces, 6 x 9 Inches)
features: Easy to past and use: the flexible mirror sheets are designed with blue protective film on the surface (to protect the surface of the mirror from being destroyed or scratched in the process of transportation), just need to be stripped before use. Warm prompt: The mirror is very thin need to stick on the wall of the very smooth surface,otherwise, the imaging results will be affected, please understanding and cautious to buy the product

Quality material: made of PET material, our flexible non-glass mirrors have smooth surface and good texture, self-adhesive back side is convenient for you to use; If there are stains or fingerprints, use a cloth or cotton cloth to gently wipe

Wide applications: these tiles mirror stickers can not only work as interior decorations for TV background wall, room, door, closet, bathroom, bedroom, sofa, children room, ceiling and more, but also suitable for working as a glass mirror in bedroom, living room, changing room, kitchen, gym, office, etc.; Please wipe the pasted surface clean before using

What you get: the package provides you with 35 pieces mirror sheets with smooth surfaces, each measures approx. 23 x 15 cm/ 9 x 6 inches and 0.2 mm thick; You can use your imagination to cut mirror sheets into any shape to decorate the walls, which will make your home look different and more attractive

Reflective effect: our mirror paste with reflective effect can be applied for nice decorations; Reflective surfaces can make the space look larger and brighter; Please use mirror paste on a smooth surface, the flatter the wall, the better the reflection; Note: mirror stickers are not real mirrors
